messages:
Aria Patel: kicking off RC build for inference-service (candidate commit 8f3c). pinning artifact to rc-2026-03-22 and disabling QProfile.
Samir Gupta: acknowledged. please exclude quantization flags — previous RC saw regressions on int paths.
Aria Patel: yep — building with QProfile=none. starting CI.
deploy-bot: build queued: inference-service@8f3c, job #4722. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4722
Lena Cho: smoke harness ready. I'll run latency + kv-warm + regen tests once deployed to test-north.
Kai Nguyen: reminder — DB migration flag (feature/db-shard) is gated for this cycle. unless we explicit, skip it during promo.
Aria Patel: agreed. skipping migration for initial promotion. plan: canary -> perf smoke -> staged promo during 23:00-02:00 UTC window.
Lena Cho: deploying to test-north canary now. attaching quick curl check: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://test-north.api/redwood/infer | jq .latency; done```
deploy-bot: deploy to test-north succeeded — replicas=3, pod/template=inf-service-8f3c.
Lena Cho: smoke pass: p50 85ms, p95 170ms, p99 195ms; kv-warm hit=95%. no obvious errors in logs.
ops_oncall: FYI saw a transient 503 at 1736057921 during pod restart. investigating but looks like healthcheck blip.
Aria Patel: saw the same 503, traced to tomcat-threadpool cap. increased pool to 150 in staging config and re-ran smoke. stable now.
Samir Gupta: thumbs up. I'm comfortable with promo if oncall keeps an eye. signoffs: @Lena Cho, @Kai Nguyen, @ops_oncall please ack.
Lena Cho: ack — smoke good.
Kai Nguyen: ack — no DB migration, approve promo.
ops_oncall: ack — oncall ready, standby. monitoring playbook linked: internal/rc-promo-playbook.
Aria Patel: starting staged promotion. target prod artifact: inference-service:8f3c, rollout strategy: batch 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, wait=5m between batches. thresholds: errors >0.5% or latency +5% p95 triggers rollback.
deploy-bot: starting promotion to prod for inference-service@8f3c. batch=10%, strategy=linear, wait=5m.
Aria Patel: monitoring dashboards up. look for error spikes and token-generation tail increase.
Lena Cho: seeing slight tail drift at 30m but within thresholds (p99 +3%). KV hit steady.
Samir Gupta: call the rollback rule if errors >1% or sustained QoS drop. rollback plan: pin traffic back to inference-service@7f9b and flip routing (script: infra/ops/rollback-promote.sh).
deploy-bot: promotion progressing: 10% -> 30% -> 60% (no blocking signals).
deploy-bot: promotion complete — 100% traffic at 1736057960. prod deploy finished.
Aria Patel: drafting release notes: - inference-service v8.3-rc (commit 8f3c): improved KV cache handling, disabled model quantization for stability; p50 latency down ~10%; added additional threadpool headroom.
Samir Gupta: added changelog entry and updated RC checklist. tagging release artifacts and closing this RC thread. great work everyone :tada:
Aria Patel: closing thread. :shipit:
